knowledge-intelligence.title: Intelligent extraction
knowledge-intelligence.lineage_hint: This record traces the first project draft. It does not mean publication, organization sharing or execution approval; later edits retain their own project revision chain.
knowledge-intelligence.intro: Ask a configured model to refine existing project sources into memory, a specification or a reusable skill. Review the proposal before creating a project draft.
knowledge-intelligence.quote_hint: Leave blank to use the complete source at this version. An excerpt must match one continuous passage exactly.
knowledge-intelligence.full_source: Use the complete source at the fixed version.
knowledge-intelligence.no_profile: No enabled, available Suma read-only tool with knowledge extraction capability is in the loaded tools. Configure the model and endpoint, then refresh its actual observation.
knowledge-intelligence.not_health: This is model configuration, not verified account health. Only a real call confirms access.
knowledge-intelligence.budget_help: One model call, with no tool execution. Output allowance and current project or organization admission limits still apply.
knowledge-intelligence.model_ack: I agree to send the selected fixed source text and extraction goal to this tool's configured model.
knowledge-intelligence.empty_history: No extraction records have been returned.
knowledge-intelligence.source_changed: The fixed source has changed. The proposal remains readable; create a new extraction before adoption.
knowledge-intelligence.invalid_json: The advanced JSON cannot be read as a proposal. Its original text is retained. Open Advanced JSON and correct it before editing these fields or saving.
knowledge-intelligence.proposal_help: Edit the title, summary, content, rationale and selected zero-based source_indices. Save the revised proposal before adopting it.
knowledge-intelligence.invalid_proposal: The proposal does not meet the fixed schema or references an unavailable source index.
knowledge-intelligence.save_before_adopt: Unsaved proposal changes cannot be adopted. Save and review them first.
knowledge-intelligence.rebase: Read latest version and keep proposal
knowledge-intelligence.original_unavaila: Original text is not available for display. Its retained digest is shown below.
knowledge-intelligence.draft_ack: I approve creating this saved proposal as a project draft. It is not published, shared or authorized for execution; normal project review still applies.
knowledge-intelligence.adopted_help: This adoption created an independent project draft. Open project knowledge to see its current publication status; organization sharing requires separate approval.
knowledge-intelligence.selection_hint: Start from fixed project sources, or select an existing extraction to inspect its actual run and proposal.
knowledge-intelligence.recovery_help: Recover the same saved operation before another change. Its source versions, original excerpts, model, limits and approval are retained.
knowledge-intelligence.saved: Operation confirmed. Reading current extraction facts.
knowledge-intelligence.adopted: Project draft created; publication remains a separate review.
knowledge-intelligence.invalid_read: The extraction response does not match the current project or expected contract.
knowledge-intelligence.access_changed: Current access to this extraction has ended. Reload the current project view.
knowledge-intelligence.refresh_failed: Current extraction facts could not be refreshed. The reviewed draft is retained.
knowledge-intelligence.reason.invalid_ou: The model output does not satisfy the fixed knowledge proposal contract.
knowledge-intelligence.reason.source_cha: Knowledge sources have changed; create a new extraction.
knowledge-intelligence.reason.profile_in: Select a current enabled read-only Suma knowledge extraction profile.
knowledge-intelligence.reason.version_co: The extraction has changed; read the latest version before deciding.
knowledge-intelligence.reason.model_conf: Confirm sending the selected source text to the configured model.
knowledge-intelligence.reason.draft_conf: Confirm creating a model-assisted project draft that still requires publication review.
knowledge-intelligence.reason.execution_: The extraction execution did not complete successfully.
The extraction outcome is unknown; inspect the original run.
knowledge-intelligence.reason.prompt_lim: The selected context is too large. Choose smaller source excerpts before extraction.
knowledge-intelligence.reason.source_una: The extraction creator no longer has current execution authority.
